# dm/third_party: third-party code

This is code written by others, shipped with the repository so there is nothing to download. Each component keeps its original license, and the license file sits in its own directory.

| Directory | What it is | Version and changes | Where it is used | License file |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fidelityfx-fsr1/` | AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1: the GPU headers `ffx_a.h` and `ffx_fsr1.h` (EASU upscaling and RCAS sharpening) | v1.0.2 (upstream commit `a21ffb8f6c`), unmodified | Android: the present's FSR 1 upscale, `DM_VK_FSR=1` (`dm/gfx/vk_android/vka_present.c`, shaders in `dm/gfx/vk_android/fsr/`) | `fidelityfx-fsr1/LICENSE.txt` (MIT) |
| `flip/` | NVIDIA FLIP, an image difference metric that models human viewing. `FLIP.h` plus the source of the command-line tool in `tool/` | Not recorded in the directory | Verification: the image quality measurements in `dm/verify/gfxq/`; build `flip` first with `make -C dm/third_party/flip` | `flip/LICENSE` (BSD 3-Clause) |
| `libadrenotools/` | libadrenotools (custom Adreno GPU driver loading) with liblinkernsbypass in `lib/linkernsbypass/`: the driver loader and its two hook libraries | Eden's `8ba23b42d7` (linkernsbypass `aa3975893d`), the files listed in `libadrenotools/README.md`; one addition in `src/hook/main_hook.c` (a no-op `AIBinder_Class_setTransactionCodeToFunctionNameMap` stub, see that README) | Android: `DM_VK_DRIVER` loads a custom Vulkan driver such as Turnip (`dm/gfx/vk_android/vka_driver.c`, android/README.md "Custom GPU drivers") | `libadrenotools/LICENSE` and `libadrenotools/lib/linkernsbypass/LICENSE` (BSD 2-Clause) |
| `libvpx/` | The VP9 decoder from libvpx: the 71 source files a VP9-decoder-only build compiles, their headers, and the generated configuration in `config/` | v1.17.0 (upstream commit `6df3ec3`), unmodified | Host: decodes the games' VP9 movies (`dm/host/hle_movie.c`). `dm/host/Makefile` builds it into `gen/vpx/libvpx.a`; the iOS build compiles the same files | `libvpx/LICENSE` (BSD 3-Clause), with the patent grant in `libvpx/PATENTS` |
| `stb_vorbis/` | Ogg Vorbis decoder, a single file `stb_vorbis.c` | 1.22 (upstream commit `1ee679c`), unmodified | Host: decodes the Vorbis sound tracks of the games' WebM movies (`dm/host/hle_movie.c`, which includes the file with its push-data API only) | `stb_vorbis/LICENSE` (MIT or public domain, your choice; the same text ends `stb_vorbis.c`) |
| `ryujinx/` | The shader translation library from Ryujinx, three projects: `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader`, `Ryujinx.Common`, `Spv.Generator` | Ryujinx 1.3.2, with the local changes listed in `ryujinx/README.md` | Referenced by the shader translation tool `dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_xlate`, which translates the original Switch shaders to SPIR-V | `ryujinx/LICENSE.txt` (MIT); `ryujinx/src/Spv.Generator/LICENSE` is that subproject's own license text; `Instructions/InstEmitAmpereMesh.cs` (NVN2 task / mesh stage memory, after switch2mac's `nx2_lower`) is GPL-3.0-or-later, `ryujinx/COPYING.GPL-3.0`, so the built translator is a GPL-3.0-or-later combined work (`ryujinx/README.md`) |
| `vulkan-headers/` | The Vulkan C headers: `vulkan_core.h`, `vk_platform.h`, `vulkan_vi.h` and the `vk_video/` headers they include | Vulkan-Headers 1.4.363, unmodified | Host: the Vulkan layer on Metal (`dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m`) that runs Hades | `vulkan-headers/LICENSE.md` (Apache-2.0 or MIT, your choice) |
| `zstd-zbic/` | libzbicdec: Zstandard's decoder sources with an MIT reader of ZBIC's entropy tables and the ZBIC frame magic in `zbic/` (the ZBIC segments of system 22.0.0+ NSO modules) | v1.5.7, `lib/` unmodified, the changes listed in `zstd-zbic/README.md` | Packer: `dm/tools/nso.py` through ctypes; the APK's `libzbicdec.so` (`android/ondevice/build.sh`) | `zstd-zbic/LICENSE` (BSD); `zbic/` MIT |
| `zstd/` | Zstandard's decompressor as one file, `zstddeclib.c` (zstd's own single-file decoder build) | v1.5.6, unmodified | Android: the Vulkan replay decompresses the shader library's SPIR-V modules (`dm/gfx/vk_android/vka_shlib.c`) | `zstd/LICENSE` (BSD) |

A few more notes:

- `flip/tool/` also carries three single-header libraries used by the FLIP command-line tool: `stb_image.h` (2.23), `stb_image_write.h` (1.13) and `tinyexr.h`. Their license notices are in the files themselves.
- `fidelityfx-fsr1/README.md`, `libadrenotools/README.md`, `libvpx/README.md`, `stb_vorbis/README.md`, `ryujinx/README.md`, `vulkan-headers/README.md`, `zstd/README.md` and `zstd-zbic/README.md` record where each came from and what it is used for.
- Four pieces of third-party code live outside this directory: `dm/gfx/nvn/include/nvn.h` (MIT, author named in the file header), the layout size algorithm in `dm/gfx/nvn/nvn_tex.c`, ported from deko3d (zlib license), and two adapted from MacNativeGames (MIT, license text in `macnativegames/LICENSE`): in `dm/gfx/nvn/nvn_mtl.m` the GPU widening of 8-bit indices (`wide_*`) and the in-pass clear triangles (`clear_color_tri` / `clear_ds_tri`), from its `widen_u8_gpu` and `clear_quad` / `clear_ds_quad`, and the Tears of the Kingdom visibility-counter lowering in `dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_xlate/Program.cs` (`VertexCounterLowering`).
